prompts.ground: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: Rasta Quest unarmed body animation authoring sheet, NOT a finished sprite export. Input image1: approved appearance reference; image2: detailed identity/clothing reference. Create one transparent 2 by 2 sheet, four distinct consecutive full-body RIGHT-FACING grounded axe-swing BODY poses at exactly the same drawing scale, same head size and planted floor. No axe or other weapon: a separate rigid axe will be composited into the closed near fist. Preserve black male face, thick tied-back dreadlocks, red yellow green band, cream sleeveless shirt with brown diagonal strap, red split sash, green pants, brown gold-buckled boots, wrapped forearms. Polished crisp premium pixel-art clusters, no blocky mannequin, no added jewelry, no glow/shadow/background/text. Pose1 already committed forward-strike with near fist extended chest-high ahead of body; pose2 forceful forward reach torso twist, near fist ahead at waist; pose3 descending follow-through fist ahead at hip; pose4 compact low follow-through fist ahead of thigh. Right-facing profile or slight three-quarter consistent with reference; NO back view. Keep upper arm anatomy plausible, fingers closed around an imaginary narrow shaft, far hand near abdomen not crossing near fist. Equal isolated 2x2 cells with broad transparent gutters, all hair/feet fully in cell, no duplicate poses. Same crown-to-soles scale in all cells, dynamic weight shift but no stepping far. No anticipation pose, attack is active from first frame. One coherent four-key swing sheet.
prompts.air: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: Rasta Quest airborne axe-swing BODY authoring sheet. Input images are identity/style reference only. Create one transparent wide sheet of THREE equally spaced full-body RIGHT-FACING airborne melee swing poses at one shared drawing scale and head size, no weapon; a separate rigid axe will attach to closed near fist. Same black male face, tied-back thick dreadlocks with red/yellow/green band, cream sleeveless top, brown diagonal strap, red split sash with yellow trim, green pants, brown buckled boots, wrapped forearms. Preserve refined pixel-art style and deliberate clusters, never geometric placeholder. Pose1 airborne torso leans forward, knees bent, fist forward near shoulder; pose2 airborne extended attack, near fist forward waist high, legs staggered bent; pose3 downward follow-through near fist forward hip high, knees gathered for descent. Fists clearly separated from torso with empty space ahead for axe. All face right, no back view, no axe, no added symbols/jewelry, no motion trails, no effects, no ground/shadow/text. All hair and boots inside separate equal cells, broad transparent gutters. Three distinct connected action keys, body density consistent, actual transparent alpha. No landing/sitting pose.
prompts.hurt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: two-key hurt BODY authoring sheet for Rasta Quest. Input images identity and style refs. Transparent wide sheet, TWO separate full-body right-facing poses, identical drawing scale and clothing/head proportions to refs. Black warrior with red/yellow/green headband and tied thick dreadlocks, cream sleeveless top, diagonal brown strap, red split sash/yellow trim, green pants, brown buckled boots and wrapped forearms. No axe: independent axe added later. Key1 sudden restrained recoil backwards, shoulders drawn back, face wince, knees flexed, near closed fist ahead of abdomen clearly separated from torso. Key2 lower recovering recoil, slight bend, feet still grounded, near closed fist lowered but ahead. Preserve facial dignity and identity, NO gore/blood/wounds, no stars/hearts/effects, no new jewelry/symbols, no text/background/shadows. Refined crisp pixel-art style; avoid blocky mannequin. Two isolated equal cells broad gutters; all hair/boots visible; no duplicate pose. Floor same in both; full character same scale.
prompts.death: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: Rasta Quest four-key non-gory death BODY authoring sheet. Input images style/identity reference. One transparent landscape 2x2 sheet, FOUR isolated full-body poses of SAME right-facing black warrior with tied-back thick dreadlocks, red/yellow/green headband, cream sleeveless shirt, brown diagonal strap, red split sash/yellow trim, green pants, brown/gold boots, wrapped forearms. Fixed anatomical drawing scale across all four keys, NO fitting each pose to cell height. Key1 knees buckle, upper body slumps forward, both fists low; key2 drops to one knee, head bowed, body contracts; key3 falls sideways toward right, forearm catches ground and legs fold; key4 resting on his side fully horizontal on floor, eyes closed, body intact and recognizable. All four keep face/profile to right, preserve head size and outfit, no weapon in any pose, no effects, no gore or blood, no tombstone, no ghost, no symbols, no new ornaments. Polished premium pixel-art clusters, readable face and boots, no geometric placeholder. Equal roomy cells with transparent gutters, horizontal final body fully inside cell, shared FLOOR edge across each row, no text, no shadows/background. Distinct four keys, fully transparent alpha.
